integrity: Underlying type-B fan and signed majorization facts are credited to the cited literature; the novel assertion is the sharp extremal Euclidean radius ratio over the entire deformation class. Numeric checker is supplementary and not a formal proof.
scientific_limitations: All-dimensional bound is proved for full-dimensional Euclidean type-B Coxeter deformations; the complete equality set of nonsymmetric extremizers is not classified, and historical priority for the sharp metric optimization remains provisional.
title: Sharp Euclidean roundness of type-\(B\) generalized permutohedra
